controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color from its measured spectrum; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of the star's measured spectrum (HST/STIS Next Generation Spectral Library v2 (Heap & Lindler; MAST high-level science product), HD 20630). The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,776 K and log g 4.53 (u1 0.460, u2 0.260): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
